title: How do I edit a survey?
intent: This article explains how to use the survey editor to add and modify questions and elements.
short_answer: To edit a survey, open it from your Forms list and navigate to the Editor page. The editor provides a drag-and-drop interface for adding questions, text elements, sections, and other components. Changes are saved when you click Save. If the survey is already published, edits create pending changes that must be applied separately.
prerequisites: The user must be the survey owner or have FormManagement local privilege
The survey must not be archived or frozen
procedure: Open the survey from the Forms list.
Use the toolbox on the left to add new elements (drag and drop or click).
Click on existing elements to select and modify their properties.
Configure element properties in the properties panel.
Set mandatory status, help text, and other options as needed.
Click Save to persist your changes.
If published, navigate to Overview and Apply Changes to make edits live.
important_conditions: If the survey is published, edits create pending changes visible via 'Show pending changes'.
Elements can be reordered via drag-and-drop.
The editor validates XHTML content on save.
Undo/redo functionality is available for recent changes.
Complex surveys may trigger a complexity warning.
Element shortnames (identifiers) must be unique within the survey.
troubleshooting: 'Your input cannot be processed (XHTML invalid)': The text contains invalid HTML. Remove special formatting.
'This element is locked': The element was locked by the system and cannot be edited.
Changes not appearing for respondents: Apply pending changes after editing a published survey.
